text:
Build full‑stack LLM web apps in pure Python!

Reflex is a Python framework that lets you build web apps with both frontend and backend entirely in Python.

If you are building LLM‑powered web apps, the easiest way to start is usually Streamlit.

But when you need more than quick prototypes like handling complex state, custom workflows, or production‑grade apps, you quickly hit its limits.

Reflex solves this:

• Pure Python – Build both frontend and backend without touching JavaScript
• True full‑stack – Handle complex workflows with built‑in state management
• Production‑ready – Deploy with a single command or host it yourself

It’s 100% open source.

Link to the repo in the comments!
